nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
# Plate Book: plates for a book
Put up to three photos from your collection in ComfyUI/input as collection_01.png, collection_02.png, collection_03.png (examples/images/met_0*.png are CC0 Met objects that work). Write what the book is about in **Book prompt**. **House look** is the specimen-on-black style shared by every plate; edit it once to restyle the whole book.

One run makes five plates in ComfyUI/output/plate_book/: 00_cover (object 1, small on black, room for the title), 01-03 one plate per object (each matched to the cover's light via image 2), 04_group (the three plates together).

Then lay out the book: `python scripts/make_book.py --spec book.json --images <folder with collection + plates> --out out/` (cover gradient map, contents, numbered chapters, captions). The model never draws the type; the script sets it.

Lightning 4-step ON (4 steps, CFG 1), seed fixed at 20261103 (inside the shared subgraph). LoRA slot: bypassed LoraLoader inside the subgraph (placeholder plate_book_style_lora.safetensors).

Status: NOT RUN YET. Built from the same Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 subgraph as the author's other entries; untested as a whole.

nodes.title: KSampler settings
widgets_values:
You can test and find the best setting by yourself. The following table is for reference.
|   | Qwen | Comfy |
|--------|---------|------------|
| Steps  | 40      | 20         |
| CFG    | 4.0     | 4.0       |

nodes.title: Book prompt (what the book is about)
widgets_values: Four objects from a museum's open collection, each one photographed as a specimen on black. Make them into a short manual: what the objects are, how to ask a model for a plate, and how to keep a set of plates looking like one book.

nodes.title: House look (shared by every plate)
widgets_values: Photoreal specimen photograph for a printed catalogue: the object alone on a pure, flat, seamless black ground, one large soft key light from above left, a thin rim light from behind, no fill light, a deep clean shadow under the object, true-to-life colour and material, 100 mm macro lens at eye level, sharp focus across the whole object, generous empty black space around it. An unedited real photograph, not a render: no CGI look, no plastic surfaces, no glow, no halo, no sparkles, no props, no hands, no text, no labels.

nodes.title: Negative prompt (shared, anti-slop; only used with Lightning off)
widgets_values: text, letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, museum label, ruler, colour chart, scale bar, watermark, logo, signage, handwriting, backdrop paper, grey backdrop, gradient backdrop, table, tabletop, hands, people, CGI, 3D render, plastic look, waxy, airbrushed, cartoon, illustration, anime, glowing edges, rim glow halo, bloom, sparkles, stars, oversaturated, neon colours, HDR, duplicate object, extra objects

nodes.title: Look + book prompt
widgets_values: Context for the whole series (do not draw any text):

nodes.title: Plate prompt - 00 Cover plate
widgets_values: Cover plate. Rephotograph the object from image 1 as a single specimen: keep its exact shape, proportions, colours, material, carving and surface wear; remove the original backdrop, table, museum labels and rulers. Place it small and centred in the frame, slightly below the middle, with wide empty black above and around it.

nodes.title: Plate prompt - 01 Plate - object 1
widgets_values: Plate. Rephotograph the object from image 1 as a specimen: keep its exact shape, proportions, colours, material and details; remove its backdrop, table, museum labels and rulers. Show only this one object. Three-quarter view, centred, the object filling about half of the frame.

nodes.title: Plate prompt - 02 Plate - object 2
widgets_values: Plate. Rephotograph the object from image 1 as a specimen: keep its exact shape, proportions, colours, material and details; remove its backdrop, table, museum labels and rulers. Show only this one object. Three-quarter view, centred, the object filling about half of the frame.

nodes.title: Plate prompt - 03 Plate - object 3
widgets_values: Plate. Rephotograph the object from image 1 as a specimen: keep its exact shape, proportions, colours, material and details; remove its backdrop, table, museum labels and rulers. Show only this one object. Three-quarter view, centred, the object filling about half of the frame.

nodes.title: Plate prompt - 04 Group plate
widgets_values: Group plate. The objects from image 1, image 2 and image 3 together on one pure black ground, set apart in a loose row like specimens laid out on a museum tray, each keeping its exact shape, colours and material, each scaled so all three read clearly, lit exactly as in image 1. Nothing else in the frame.

text, letters, words, captions, labels, tape, stickers, handwriting, signage, watermark, logo, CGI, 3D render, plastic skin, plastic look, waxy, airbrushed, cartoon, illustration, anime, video game, glowing edges, rim glow, halo, oversaturated, neon colours, numbers, typography, font, garbled text, cluttered panel
The "Edit Model Reference Method" nodes above are not needed if you use Comfy files, but may be needed if you use repackaged ones from other people.
